test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Piu and Titu start from the same place at the same time and walk in opposite directions. If Piu walks at 5 km/h and Titu walks at 2 km/h, after what time will they be 10.5 km apart?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When moving in opposite directions, the relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds.

Relative speed = 5 + 2 = 7 km/h

Time = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed

Time = 10.5 ÷ 7 = 1.5 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 1.5 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Piu = 5 km/h

Speed of Titu = 2 km/h

Total distance apart = 10.5 km

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Relative Speed (in opposite directions) = Speed₁ + Speed₂

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba8796fe745a1a0db7716794a5218920445b309df5e4ed51bc66876cad29776b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the time taken for them to be 10.5 km apart be t hours.

⇒ Distance covered by Piu in time t = 5 × t = 5t km

⇒ Distance covered by Titu in time t = 2 × t = 2t km

⇒ Since they are moving in opposite directions, the total distance is the sum of their individual distances.

⇒ Total distance = 5t + 2t

⇒ 7t = 10.5

⇒ t = 10.5 ÷ 7

⇒ t = 1.5 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 1.5 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Same Direction

When two bodies move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference between their individual speeds. Relative Speed = |Speed₁ − Speed₂|.

Average Speed

If an object covers two equal distances at speeds S₁ and S₂ respectively, the overall average speed is given by (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert from m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.
